question: Monthly reversal selection within prior-traded-amount strata: does it improve return/risk or add information after coarse historical-volatility control?
financial_hypothesis: Temporary demand/supply pressure may reverse; historical traded amount stratifies activity. Low activity can instead mean stale quotes, bad information, wide spreads and large trading friction. No small-cap/retail/causal claim.
decision: retain specific monthly selection use or pause; do not adopt trading
financial_scope: Independent stock research extension; no LEI signal/rule changes; stock evidence not ETF evidence
input_universe: Fixed2014 historical300 cohort; reuse original36019 all-four-score-qualified code-month rows. Current index members not used. Four index populations and separate downside-risk work owned by other chats.
period_status: All seen history; no fit/tuning/untouched validation

amount.rule: mean over last60 scheduled market dates; all60 raw rows required; explicit suspended zero included; missing/blank/nonfinite/negative/unknown status rejected with reason
amount.partition: three near-equal count partitions ascending amount then code, separately each month, no future outcomes

selection: Within each amount stratum five reversal score groups sorted ascending -hot then code; lowvol same name count as G5. rev_volbalanced splits ascending vol60/code into two near-equal halves, each selects max(1,floor(n_half/5)) highest -hot/code; each half retains n_half/N capital weight; selected equal within half.
conditional_claim: G5 vs lowvol is choice substitution, not information independence. rev_volbalanced vs pool tests coarse volatility-controlled increment only; report realized vol60/momentum exposures, no exact neutrality.
account: Independent open-only quote scenario; month-end targets executed at next market date open, prior holdings bear overnight prices; sell before buy with cash scaling and no reallocation of failed buys. Fractional adjusted quote units; no real lot/call-auction queue/cash dividend claim.
timing: open validity uses current raw open/preclose/effective foreAdjustFactor and prior-day confirmed basis, assumed open-known status; never uses same-day high/low/volume/close/pctChg/whole-day source_valid. Same-day closing audit marks broken at close, cannot cancel old opening trade. Missing/open failure keeps cash or old holding. Unknown valuation remains visible plus zero-unknown value sensitivity, not worst-case-path proof.
primary_benchmark: same amount stratum monthly rebalanced full eligible pool, same cost scenario; not parent index

market_reference.identity: CSI300 price index only, not total-return mother index for fixed300
market_reference.use: context only, no costed index excess alpha claim

selection: five group outcomes on shared complete months and known contribution separately
G5 vs lowvol and volbalanced vs pool
retained known >=20pct future winners; not cash PnL
account: up/down passive months with opportunity costs

uncertainty: paired calendar HAC3; retain calendar slots with missing not compress gaps; intervals descriptive, no probability of truth or invented meaningful threshold. Report all groups and periods, not select a favorable universe.
essential_checks: same-day postopen fields cannot affect open orders
period contradiction and leave-one-year mean increment diagnostic without rerunning accounts
method_route: Native prediction-ridge/binary workflow does not implement conditional sorting/account question. Reuse frozen project inputs and existing accounting structure in separately scoped new research adapter; not claim native prediction certification.
family_history: Existing short-reversal/300 sorting/84 quote account/time-regime and SPY results reused, not rerun; all prior attempts remain. This new question changes ex-ante activity strata and explicitly separates opening from closing audit; not a parameter rescue.
